messages:
jeff (Docs): FYI, linkcheck in the i18n PR is failing on encoded anchors and a fenced codeblock that's not closing. CI attached.
ci-bot: build failed — mkdocs linkcheck: 7 broken fragment links, 1 markdown parse error
maria (i18n): thanks. which page? I can repro locally with the locale build
jeff (Docs): /docs/zh-cn/guide/overview.md — anchor `%E2%80%8Bdetails` (zero-width space) got encoded, linkchecker treats it as mismatch. Also saw this snippet: 
```md
### Integration steps​
1. ...
```
sam (CI): looks like the zero-width char sneaks into headings when copying from Notion. linkcheck compares slugified anchors, hence mismatch.
nina (devex): quick fix: run `sed -i 's/\xE2\x80\x8B//g'` on staged files, but we should add a pre-commit check
maria (i18n): agreed. I'll open a tiny PR to strip ZWSP and normalize heading whitespace for localized branches
jeff (Docs): also need to close the fenced codeblock in overview.md — missing trailing ``` caused the TOC plugin to abort in docusaurus build.
sam (CI): re-ran after patch — CI green for linkcheck, but mkdocs nav still warns about duplicated anchors in translated pages
nina (devex): created hook: `scripts/normalize-headings.py` + pre-commit entry. I'll link PR: <https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4123>
jeff (Docs): thanks all :rocket: — leaving a note in the PR about the locale tooling. we should add a small test in CI that builds only changed locale files
ci-bot: PR 4123 linked and CI run queued.
